name: kurtosis
expr: k1 = kurtosis(x); k0 = kurtosis(x, 0); kM = kurtosis(M);
comment: Sig k=kurtosis(X[,flag[,dim]]): sample kurtosis (raw, ~3 for normal, NOT excess). Default flag=1 (biased): kurtosis([2 4 4 4 5 5 7 9])=2.78125. flag=0 (bias-corrected): 3.940625. Matrix per-column: kurtosis(magic(4)) cols (1,2)=(1.880697, 1.673068).
